subject.title: feat(browser): add secure per-tab copilot panel

question: Should this PR require the broad `sessions.subscribe` denial from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110184 as a merge precondition, and should the generic plugin `toolBindings` contract be accepted as the permanent boundary?
rationale: The linked repair addresses an unresolved cross-session disclosure path, while accepting a generic plugin context field fixes a long-lived public contract that cannot be safely inferred from this feature branch alone.

options.title: Integrate the hardening and approve a narrow contract
options.body: Require the admission-level broad-subscription denial, then approve and document the smallest stable `toolBindings` contract needed by browser-owned runs.

options.title: Keep bindings browser-private
options.body: Rework the feature so browser targeting stays behind a browser-specific owner seam instead of expanding the generic plugin tool context.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose the permanent ownership and compatibility model for capability-bound runs.

recommendation.title: Integrate the hardening and approve a narrow contract
recommendation.body: Require the admission-level broad-subscription denial, then approve and document the smallest stable `toolBindings` contract needed by browser-owned runs.
